event_unit: one main routed-layer invocation; 48 per verifier window
service_unit: token-expert lane entries; distinct uses count one layer invocation even with multiple lanes
partition_scope: Only completed ordinary promotions, per run. Incomplete, mandatory restoration and sampled D2H readback are separate. Used-before-eviction includes used survivors. Native completion is certified by publication; unpublished native completion is unknown.
counter_authority: Service journal actual slot/path, chronological publication and withdrawal, then compare frozen runtime use counter and lifecycle observations. Never match only expert ID.
lease_definition: Actual first local plan service, including opportunistic pre-target use, releases at a later verifier milestone after ordered reader completion. Host event crossing target alone does not satisfy use. Target+48 expires bounded intent.
protection_bound: 16 per device/class inside ordinary capacity; five existing charged spare slots. NO_SWAP retains required CPU/mapped computation.
native_unknowns: exclusive full native adaptation planner time
tail_censoring: Generation-specific prefix-surviving unused residents followed through the observed continuous tail; no infinite-future claim.
cheap_history_mapping: Frozen Phase1 native proxy: rate=max(0, causally updated native heat)*0.089168735; p_H=1-exp(-rate*H), H in {1,4,16,64} main windows. No fresh calibration on regression/new-source outcomes.

guard_units.incoming_frontier: E64 routed-layer invocations, fixed candidate order
guard_units.incoming_utility_window: 768 routed-layer invocations supplied by existing incoming oracle
guard_units.copy_entry_equivalent: (unique expert bytes/25e9 + unique expert bytes/13.2e9)/160e-6; assumed benefit per lane entry
guard_units.near_target_risk: p1 for <=1 window, otherwise interpolate toward p4 over the next3 windows
guard_units.calibration_matching: Both use declared return-risk mapping and preserved native/logistic checkpoint calibration. Identical numeric thresholds alone are not claimed to guarantee identical calibration.

selection_linkage_limit: Issued proposals retain trigger/target and exact spare ownership. Rejected pre-issue proposals have aggregate reason counters, not full per-proposal records. Initial suggested victim before publication re-selection is not individually journaled; actual publication victim is authoritative.
